text: Digitalize and sell Felix Fritsch's dad's paintings from the attic
description: ~100 paintings in the attic. Photograph them consistently, measure real size, have multiple people rate aesthetics, derive prices (rating × size), and sell them online via a website with Stripe checkout and pick-up/shipping options.

supportingConnections.hypothesis: A fast, repeatable capture flow makes digitalizing all ~100 paintings feasible in a few sessions with consistent image quality and comparable sizes
Averaging several people's aesthetic ratings yields fairer, less arbitrary prices than one person deciding
A transparent rating×size formula produces consistent prices that buyers accept
A simple online shop reaches more buyers than local word-of-mouth alone and turns the attic stock into sales
Keeping capture, evaluation and shop in one app avoids syncing data between systems
